keys.majesty: majesty|\bsire\b|\bmy (king|liege|lord)\b|\bkneel|\bbow(s|ed|ing)?\b(?! and)|your highness|all hail|long live the king

lines.opener: *a pale snake no longer than your two hands rears up in the middle of the path, a white crown-mark gleaming on its head; somewhere, other snakes flee* Sssso. DECREE: the intruder shall kneel before the King.
lines.openerHostile: *the grass around it browns and curls as it hisses* The King is DISPLEASSSED. Look upon the King's face, worm. LOOK.
lines.like: *it rears a little higher, swaying with satisfaction* Yesss. The King approvesss.
lines.dislike: *the hood flares* Treassson! The King will not hear it!
lines.hate: *it shrieks, a thin, high hiss* NO! Take it AWAY! *and it whips off into a crack in the rock*
lines.flirt: *it stares at you, unblinking* ...Whatever that wasss, the King decreesss it treassson.
lines.join: *it slithers up your arm and settles on your shoulder like a living torc* DECREE: the King shall ride with this one. His enemies shall wither.
lines.demand: *it lifts its crowned head* DECREE: a tribute for the King of ssserpents. At once.
lines.gift: *it breathes on a pebble until the pebble splits, then nudges one half toward you* A royal favour. Treasssure it.
lines.thanks: *a long, pleased hiss* The tribute is acssseptable.
lines.letPass: *it turns its crowned head away* The King permitsss you to passs. Do not look back.
lines.ai: *its hood flares* The King does not know thisss word. The King suspectsss it is an insssult.
lines.refuseJoin: You ASK the King? The King is not asked. The King DECREESSS.
lines.leaveNow: *a rustle in the grass; it stiffens* Was that... a weasssel? The King has businesss elsewhere. *it slithers off very fast*
